predicted_direction: Reject a non-callable on_delete for related fields at definition or check time, naming the offending argument, rather than letting the model import cleanly and only failing deep inside the deletion collector.

predicted_direction_template.component_or_function: ForeignKey.__init__() and ForeignKey._check_on_delete() in django/db/models/fields/related.py, whose value is later invoked by Collector.collect() in django/db/models/deletion.py

predicted_direction_template.input_condition_or_trigger: A browser that still holds a messages cookie written by Django 3.1 - a plain JSON list such as [["__json_message",0,25,"Ingelogd als ..."]] followed by :1lTkj1:<signature> - hitting any view (here /user/login/) on a 3.2 install, so unsign_object feeds a 369-character non-base64 string to base64.urlsafe_b64decode.
